claims.text: The proposed NER model includes gazetteers as features, which can generalize to unseen entities, allowing it to account for named entities not listed on Wikipedia.
Wikifier features improve the extraction of named entities, indicating that the model can utilize features beyond those strictly from Wikipedia.
